core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rahmath is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Mercy, compassion”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rahmath corresponds to the Arabic form رَحْمَة (Arabic root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m); رَحْمَة (Raḥma)). Its core sense is rahmath; mercy, compassion. Rahmath is a spelling variant of Arabic رَحْمَة (Raḥma) 'mercy, compassion', from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Mercy, Compassion' is consistent. Same name as rahmat.
